handoff_instructions: ChatGPT approved: Implementation matches M2-T14 scope: service authorizes communication.write, enforces org scoping for voice calls, updates call/communication, records a business event with an idempotency key using (orgId, providerEventId), and writes an audit entry only on first process. Replays short-circuit with no second event/audit/mutation. Multi-tenant isolation and authorization are respected; audit and idempotency covered. Tests validate happy path, idempotency, cross-org NotFound, and permission denial. No work outside task. Optional future hardening: consider including provider name or communicationId in idempotency key to reduce risk of cross-call collisions if a provider ever reuses event IDs, but not required for this task.. M2-T14 is done. Next: M2-T15 "SMS adapter (Twilio)".
